sections.title: RAG Applications for Atlanta Organizations
sections.description: Production RAG solutions for Atlanta's leading organizations.

blocks.heading: Payments and FinTech Regulatory RAG
paragraphs: For NCR (Atlanta HQ), Global Payments (Atlanta HQ), FleetCor (Atlanta HQ), and Transaction Alley's payments community:

Payment processing compliance knowledge: RAG over PCI DSS standards, state money transmitter requirements, Regulation E (electronic funds transfer), and payment network rules for NCR's and Global Payments' compliance teams — enabling natural language query of the complex multi-dimensional compliance requirements for payment processors operating in dozens of states with different licensing and consumer protection frameworks.

Merchant documentation knowledge: RAG for NCR's large merchant support organization — enabling support engineers to query technical documentation, POS configuration guides, and integration specifications for NCR's extensive product portfolio without manual documentation search.

Financial crime compliance RAG: RAG over FinCEN BSA/AML regulations, OFAC sanctions lists, and financial crime typologies for FleetCor's and the Atlanta FinTech community's anti-financial crime compliance teams.
Cost: $40,000–$110,000 | Timeline: 10–20 weeks | PCI DSS, FinCEN context

blocks.heading: Healthcare Clinical Knowledge RAG
paragraphs: For Emory Healthcare, Children's Healthcare of Atlanta, Grady Health, and Piedmont Healthcare:

Clinical guideline and protocol RAG: RAG over Emory's Epic-integrated clinical protocols, evidence-based clinical guidelines, and hospital formulary for Emory's large clinical workforce — enabling physicians and nurses to query current evidence-based standards in natural language at the point of care.

CHOA pediatric knowledge RAG: Pediatric-specific clinical knowledge RAG for Children's Healthcare of Atlanta's clinical teams — incorporating pediatric dosing references, developmental milestone standards, and pediatric disease management guidelines calibrated to the pediatric patient population.
Health system policy documentation: RAG over HR policies, compliance requirements, and operational procedures for Emory's and Grady's large healthcare employee populations.
Cost: $40,000–$110,000 | Timeline: 10–18 weeks | HIPAA BAA

blocks.heading: Logistics and Supply Chain Intelligence RAG
paragraphs: For UPS (Atlanta suburb HQ), Home Depot (Atlanta HQ), and Delta Air Lines (Atlanta HQ):

UPS network operations knowledge: RAG over UPS's extensive internal operating procedures, routing guides, and technical documentation for UPS's large operations workforce — enabling package car drivers, air operations crews, and hub workers to query relevant procedures in natural language.

Home Depot product and sourcing knowledge: RAG for Home Depot's large buyer and category management teams — natural language query of supplier specifications, product certification documentation, and category performance data.
Delta Air Lines operational documentation: RAG over Delta's flight operations, maintenance, and customer service documentation for Delta's 80,000+ employee workforce.
Cost: $35,000–$100,000 | Timeline: 8–18 weeks

blocks.heading: Media Research Intelligence RAG
paragraphs: For CNN (Atlanta HQ), Turner Broadcasting, and Cox Media Group:
News archive RAG: RAG over CNN's decades of news archive for journalists and producers researching historical coverage — enabling natural language query of CNN's institutional knowledge base.
Market research intelligence: RAG for Cox Media's advertising sales and marketing teams — querying audience research, advertising rate data, and competitive media intelligence in natural language.
Regulatory and FCC compliance: RAG over FCC broadcast regulations and content guidelines for Atlanta's broadcasters managing complex regulatory compliance requirements.
Cost: $35,000–$95,000 | Timeline: 8–18 weeks

sections.title: Atlanta RAG Technical Context
sections.description: Key considerations for RAG development in Atlanta.

blocks.heading: Payment processing data sensitivity
paragraphs: Atlanta's payment processing RAG must handle PCI DSS-sensitive cardholder data governance — ClickMasters designs payments RAG with strict PCI DSS scope limitation, ensuring that full cardholder data (PANs, CVVs) never enters the RAG pipeline.

blocks.heading: Large workforce documentation
paragraphs: UPS, Home Depot, and Delta collectively employ hundreds of thousands of workers — enterprise RAG for these organizations must scale to simultaneous queries from thousands of users while maintaining sub-second response times. ClickMasters designs large-workforce RAG with the horizontal scaling and caching architecture that population-scale deployment requires.
